sections.title: Income Tax Department
sections.text: If any person, who is required to furnish information under section 397(3)(d), fails to furnish such information, or furnishes inaccurate information, the Assessing Officer may impose a penalty of Rs. 100000 on such person.

orphans.text: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
Penalty for failure to furnish information or furnishing inaccurate information under section 397(3)(d).
